seek_immediate_evaluation: If your symptoms worsen, you develop new symptoms, or you feel your condition is deteriorating, seek emergency care immediately. Do not wait.
call_911_immediately: Call 911 immediately. Do not drive yourself to the hospital. Stay on the line with the 911 operator and follow their instructions.
monitor_symptoms: Monitor your symptoms closely. If they worsen or new symptoms develop, seek medical care promptly.
follow_up_primary_care: Schedule a follow-up appointment with your primary care provider within the recommended timeframe. If symptoms change or worsen before then, seek care sooner.
return_if_worse: Return to emergency care or call 911 if your symptoms worsen, you develop difficulty breathing, chest pain, or feel significantly worse.
stroke_warning: Remember FAST: Face drooping, Arm weakness, Speech difficulty, Time to call 911. Every minute matters in stroke treatment.
bleeding_warning: Continue to apply direct pressure. If bleeding does not stop or you feel faint, call 911 immediately.
allergy_warning: If you have an epinephrine auto-injector (EpiPen), use it immediately. Even if symptoms improve, you still need emergency evaluation.
use_epipen: If you have an epinephrine auto-injector (EpiPen), use it immediately. Call 911 even if symptoms improve after using the EpiPen.
crisis_hotline: If you are in crisis, call or text 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline) for immediate support. Help is available 24/7.
mental_health_resources: Consider reaching out to a mental health professional. Many resources are available including therapy, support groups, and crisis lines.
self_care_instructions: Rest, stay hydrated, and take over-the-counter medications as appropriate for symptom relief. Contact your doctor if symptoms persist or worsen.
avoid_injury: Avoid activities that could cause injury or bleeding. Do not take aspirin or NSAIDs without consulting your doctor.
hydration_reminder: Stay well hydrated by drinking plenty of clear fluids. Monitor for signs of dehydration such as dark urine or dizziness.
